notes.title: Update 1.1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added mapping for game restarts. See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1452790/discussions/0/4706830261926551011/]here[/url]
[/list]

[b]Undocumented Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixing (hopefully) inconsistently updating the leader board score times
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Undocumented Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a memory leak when restarting on the pause menu
[*] Updates to leaderboard initialisation. (Delete levels.dat in %localappdata%\IZBOT2\ folder if you're having issues)
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards. There is now a leaderboard per level. Best times have been reset due to some patches. You'll need to complete a level to get a leaderboard entry.
[/list]

[b]Undocumented Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Security doors weren't closing on certain death events
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Leaderboards are having some issues. Still looking into this.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an ini option to show what level you're on
[*] Add a sound effect when you beat your best time
[*] Gamepad bumpers now work in the level select screen
[/list]

[b]Undocumented Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a timer to the Pause menu to stop (or slow down) a jump glitch
[*] Left thumbstick now works on the menus
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Level leaderboards added (more to come)
[/list]

[b]Undocumented Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Levels should now be locked at the start
[*] Remove mouse click menu interaction (Keys or Gamepad)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Features 
[list]
[*] Added some more acid vats
[*] Graphical updates
[/list]

Undocumented Features
[list]
[*] Escape button wasn't working on Exit confirm screen
[*] Visual fixes on some of the tiles
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Features 
[list]
[*] Added a wishlist button to the title screen (hint hint)
[*] Removed unused assets to improve performance 
[*] Updated build pipeline to improve performance 
[/list]

Undocumented Features
[list]
[*] Menu items were able to be unselected 
[*] Improved navigation using the gamepad
[*] Visual fixes on some of the tiles
[/list]

notes.title: Madsen Update
notes.content:
Features 
[list]
[*] Hit box size on death spinners reduced
[*] Delay initial player spawn to allow camera to catch up
[*] Highlighted button is a little more prominent 
[/list]

Undocumented Features
[list]
[*] D-pad wasn't working for IZBOT movement
[*] Fix for gamepad mappings for jump and dash 
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Features 
[list]
[*] Added Stage Clear Screen - Showing times and IZBOT deaths
[*] Added setting to remove screen shake (In %localappdata%\IZBOT2\settings.ini add enableScreenShake="0")
[*] Longer timeouts for Intro Screens
[*] Performance Improvements
[/list]

Undocumented Features
[list]
[*] Intro screens would sometimes skip a screen 
[/list]
